highlights_headline: The 4.152.0 preview adds Graphite GPU backend bindings and a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package.
highlights_body: Also fixes two native use-after-free bugs in SKRegion and SKPixmap, adds backend-neutral async pixel readback, and bumps to Chrome milestone m152.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled engine to Chrome milestone m152 and merges upstream chrome/m151 stability fixes along the way.
Adds Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, alongside a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with Vulkan tests running on Android and Linux.
Adds RequestReadPixels to SKImage and SKSurface for backend-neutral asynchronous pixel reads.

Fixes a native use-after-free in SKRegion.SpanIterator by rooting the owning SKRegion, and a similar use-after-free in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and its With* methods by rooting the pixel source. Also fixes a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak on the SKImage.Create raster failure path.

bullets.lead: FreeType-based font support on Nano Server
bullets.detail: Uses FreeType for font support on Nano Server, where the platform font stack is unavailable.

Caches the HandleDictionary skip-registration reflection check, pre-sizes the SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map to its known count, and avoids an intermediate string allocation in the null-terminated GetEncodedText path.
Makes binding generation deterministic across platforms, avoiding spurious diffs between build machines.
Adds containerized test legs for Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server, and converts all .sln solutions to the .slnx format.
Initializes the MSVC environment once per native build and stops pinning a default Windows SDK version.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels support for SKImage and SKSurface
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Initializing the MSVC environment once per native build on Windows
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: The Graphite GPU backend bindings, the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, and the SKRegion/SKPixmap use-after-free fixes

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Opened the 4.152.0 line with the Graphite GPU backend bindings, the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, the SKRegion and SKPixmap use-after-free fixes, and the initial m152 Skia sync.

harfbuzz_summary: No binding-facing changes; the HarfBuzzSharp build now shares the converted .slnx solutions and the new containerized test legs.
